Braintam Admin Panel - Course Management System

Goal:
Create a scalable Course Management System that can handle thousands of courses, subjects, chapters, topics, live classes, and batches without creating large dropdown lists.

MODULE 1: COURSE MANAGEMENT

Create Course

Fields:

* Course ID (Auto Generated)
* Course Name
* Grade
* Academic Year
* Description
* Thumbnail
* Status (Active / Archived / Draft)

Example:
CRS0001 - Grade 5 CBSE 2026-27

Actions:

* Create
* Edit
* Archive
* Duplicate
* Delete

MODULE 2: SUBJECT MANAGEMENT

Inside each Course:

Fields:

* Subject ID (Auto Generated)
* Subject Name
* Subject Description
* Subject Thumbnail

Example:
SUB0001 - Mathematics

Actions:

* Create
* Edit
* Delete

MODULE 3: CHAPTER MANAGEMENT

Inside Subject:

Fields:

* Chapter ID (Auto Generated)
* Chapter Name
* Sequence Number
* Chapter Description

Example:
CHP0001 - Fractions

Actions:

* Create
* Edit
* Reorder
* Delete

MODULE 4: TOPIC MANAGEMENT

Inside Chapter:

Fields:

* Topic ID (Auto Generated)
* Topic Name
* Sequence Number
* Topic Description
* Learning Objective
* Topic Status

Example:
TOP0001 - Introduction to Fractions

Actions:

* Create
* Edit
* Duplicate
* Delete

MODULE 5: GLOBAL SEARCH

Single Search Box

Search by:

* Course ID
* Subject ID
* Chapter ID
* Topic ID
* Name

Examples:
CRS0001
SUB0001
Fractions
Grade 5

Show full breadcrumb:

Grade 5 > Mathematics > Fractions > Like Fractions

MODULE 6: LIVE CLASS CREATION

Fields:

1. Academic Year
2. Course
3. Subject
4. Chapter
5. Topic
6. Teacher
7. Batch
8. Date
9. Time
10. Duration
11. Meeting Link

Dependent Dropdown Logic:

Course Selected
→ Show Subjects

Subject Selected
→ Show Chapters

Chapter Selected
→ Show Topics

No large dropdowns should load at once.

MODULE 7: RECENT & FAVOURITES

Show:

Recent Topics
Favourite Topics

Teachers can pin frequently used topics.

MODULE 8: PROGRESS TRACKING

For every batch:

Course Progress
Subject Progress
Chapter Progress
Topic Completion

Example:

Fractions
8/10 Topics Completed
80%

MODULE 9: SMART NEXT TOPIC

When creating a live class:

Last Topic Completed:
Like Fractions

Suggested Next Topic:
Unlike Fractions

One-click selection.

MODULE 10: ARCHIVE SYSTEM

Only Active Courses should appear during Live Class Creation.

Archived Courses remain available in admin panel but hidden from normal workflows.

MODULE 11: ID SYSTEM

Auto Generate IDs

Course = CRS0001
Subject = SUB0001
Chapter = CHP0001
Topic = TOP0001
Live Class = CLS0001
Batch = BAT0001
Student = STD0001
Teacher = TCH0001

MODULE 12: DASHBOARD

Show:

* Total Courses
* Total Subjects
* Total Chapters
* Total Topics
* Total Live Classes
* Total Students
* Total Teachers
* Total Batches

Important:
System must be optimized for 10,000+ topics and future scaling. All selections should use search, filters, and dependent dropdowns instead of loading huge lists.
